description: This file defines a Perl package 'Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods' that provides shorthand methods for calling ResultSource or Schema methods, including date/time formatting and parsing, transaction execution, and boolean formatting, within the context of a database schema.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods
classes.description: A Perl package providing shorthand methods for schema and ResultSource interactions, including date/time formatting, parsing, transaction handling, and boolean conversion.

methods.name: format_date
methods.description: Formats a date using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_datetime
methods.description: Formats a datetime using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_date_today
methods.description: Formats the current date as a string.

methods.name: format_datetime_now
methods.description: Formats the current datetime as a string.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a DateTime object.

methods.name: parse_datetime
methods.description: Parses a datetime string into a DateTime object.

methods.name: txn_do
methods.description: Executes a transaction via the schema.

methods.name: format_bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 1 or 0.
